robot_params.comment: Arm-specific limits + kinematics for the operator console and the standalone grabber. EDIT THIS (or let calibration flows update it) when porting to another arm - nothing is hardcoded in the code. The planar model (fitted EXACTLY, 0.00 mm residual on 8 live poses, 2026-07-28): P = base + link1*e^i(J2+j2_offset) + link2*e^i(J2+J3+j3_offset). Feasibility = |P-base| <= link1+link2-extension_margin AND predicted J2 >= j2_min+j2_margin. reach_hard_mm/inner_reach_mm are legacy origin-circle guards used only when the kinematic block is absent.
robot_params.j4_limit_note: Operator-authorized envelope +/-220 degrees, matching S4 Hardware Manual p15. Automatic planning/queue checks retain their 5-degree buffer: effective +/-215. Preserve continuous actual joint winding; no modulo-360 reset. The Home-to-scope solution starts at measured Home J4=-140.81 and stays between -180.83 and -83.75. No +/-280 envelope is authorized or applied.
robot_params.reach_limit_note: Automatic planar reach is 390 mm from base (126, 0): 400 mm links minus 8 mm extension margin minus 2 mm planning/tracking buffer. Workspace Y maximum is 380 mm. Updated at operator request 2026-10-17; joint/wrist limits unchanged.
